nav.label: Settings sections
nav.deniedDescription: Your role does not include this section. A system admin can change what a role may open.

account.demoBody: This is a demo session with synthetic data. Use the Demo role button in the top bar to try another role.
account.managedBy: Your name and email are set by a system admin.

roleBlurb.SYSTEM_ADMIN: Sets up and checks OrderPilot. Does not approve, post or pay.
roleBlurb.PRODUCT_MANAGER: Raises stock purchase requests and follows your brands' orders and stock.
roleBlurb.APPROVER: Approves or rejects requests within your limit.
roleBlurb.SUPPORT: Confirms documents, keeps orders current, and prepares proforma invoices, invoices and packing lists.
roleBlurb.WAREHOUSE: Checks goods against the documents, then packs and releases them.
roleBlurb.FINANCE: Confirms payments, pays vendors, and clears payment holds with a second approver.
roleBlurb.LOGISTICS: Arranges forwarders and follows shipping dates, AWB or BL, and import permits.
roleBlurb.MANAGEMENT: Reads the tracker, dashboards and reports.

access.title: What you can do
access.intro: Your role is {{role}}. This is what it lets you do in OrderPilot.
access.none: Your role has no access yet. Ask a system admin to give you one.
access.footnote: Your role is set by a system admin. If you need more access, ask them.
access.everyRole: See what every role can do

inboxes.any: look at other roles' task inboxes

spr.route: route stock purchase requests to the approvers

approvals.decide: approve or reject requests within your limit

payments.confirm: confirm that a customer has paid

session.title: Session
session.label: Sign out of OrderPilot
session.description: You are signed in as {{name}}. Signing out deletes any unsaved drafts on this device.

twoStep.title: Two-step verification

row.label: Authenticator app
row.descriptionOff: Ask for a 6-digit code from your phone when you sign in with your email and password.
row.descriptionOn: A 6-digit code from your phone is asked for each time you sign in with your email and password.

recovery.label: Recovery codes
recovery.low: Only {{count}} left. Make new codes soon.

twoStep.footnote: Saved on the server, not on this device. It applies at once.
twoStep.demoSkips: The demo role buttons skip this step, so a shared demo account is never locked.
twoStep.noPassword: This account has no password, so there is no email and password sign-in for two-step to protect.
twoStep.demoAdmin: A demo session cannot turn on two-step verification for this account, because only an administrator could undo it and an administrator cannot reset their own.
twoStep.recentLock: Too many wrong codes were entered for your account on {{date}}. If that was not you, someone may know your password.

setup.scanBody: In your authenticator app, add an account and scan this code.
setup.qrTitle: QR code for your authenticator app
setup.codeLabel: Then enter the 6-digit code it shows

recoveryView.title: Save your recovery codes
recoveryView.body: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once. They are shown only now.
recoveryView.copyFailed: The codes could not be copied. Select them and copy by hand.

regenerate.title: Make new recovery codes

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.intro: The AI reads, explains and drafts. A person confirms before anything is saved, sent or paid.

model.label: Model in use
model.mock: Scripted sample answers. No real model is used.

sees.label: What it can see
sees.description: Synthetic demo data only. No real customer or Spectra document is sent to an AI service.
sees.descriptionLive: The server's data policy decides what may be sent.

probe.label: Test the connection
probe.description: Sends one fixed sample question and shows how the AI answered. No document is sent. Each test is recorded in the audit log.
probe.okTokens: The AI answered in {{ms}} ms. It read {{input}} tokens and wrote {{output}}.
probe.error: The AI did not answer. Reason: {{code}}.
probe.refused: The request was refused before it was sent. Reason: {{code}}.
probe.timeout: The AI took too long to answer. Reason: {{code}}.
probe.failed: The test could not run. Trace id {{traceId}}.
probe.footnote: The provider and model are set on the server, not here.

health.title: System health

affects.title: What this affects
affects.database: Orders and documents cannot be saved or opened.
affects.redis: Background jobs, such as reading uploaded documents, are delayed.
affects.storage: Uploaded documents cannot be saved or opened.

health.footnote: The reason for a failure is in the server log.
